author: Good Enough
description:
WASP-76 b is one of the most extreme exoplanets ever discovered, a world where it may literally rain molten iron. This ultra-hot gas giant is tidally locked, with one side permanently facing its star and reaching temperatures hot enough to vaporize metals.

Powerful winds can carry iron vapor toward the cooler night side, where it may condense and fall as liquid iron rain. This Short explores WASP-76 b, molten iron rain, extreme exoplanets, alien weather, hot Jupiters, and some of the most violent planetary conditions ever discovered.
title: This Planet Rains Molten Iron 🪐😰 #space #astronomy #exoplanets #alienplanet
